title: An optimized protocol to detect protein ubiquitination and activation by ubiquitination assay in vivo and CCK-8 assay
protocol: Seed HEK293T cells into 10 cm dishes with 60% confluence for the ubiquitination assay.
Observe cell morphology and density under a microscope.
Once cells reach 70% confluence, transfect them with indicated plasmids.
Add pre-warmed 500 μL Opti-MEM to tube A and tube B.
Add specified plasmids to tube A and mix well.
Mix 30 μL Lipofectamine® Reagent in tube B gently.
Combine diluted DNA from tube A with the contents of tube B.
Incubate the DNA-lipid complex at 20°C–25°C for 5 minutes.
Add the mixture dropwise to cells.
Change to complete culture medium after 6-8 hours post-transfection.
Harvest cells after 72 hours for ubiquitination in vivo assay.
Add MG132 at a final concentration of 10 μM.
Mix gently.
Incubate the dishes in a 37°C incubator for 3–4 hours to block protein degradation before cell collection.
Wash the cells twice with 5 mL of ice-cold 1XPBS.
Scrape cells off using a plastic scraper and transfer them into 1.5 mL EP tubes.
Centrifuge at 900 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and place the cell pellets on ice.
For the Whole Cell Extract group, add 200 μL RIPA buffer on ice for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Measure the concentration of proteins with a BCA protein assay kit.
Mix 20–30 μg protein from each sample with 2× loading buffer.
Boil the mixture for 10–15 minutes at 100°C.
Store whole extract proteins at −20°C until use.
Add 1 mL ice-cold lysis buffer A1 to the pellet and pipette up and down to lyse the cells.
Incubate the lysis solution on ice for 30 minutes.
Resuspend Ni-NTA beads by vortexing or mixing before use.
Add 50 μL Ni-NTA beads to each sample.
Incubate and shake the mixture gently at 2–8°C for 16 hours.
Centrifuge the beads at 600 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads-protein complex with buffer A1, B1, C1, and C2 respectively.
Aspirate most of the supernatant along the wall of the tube and keep 50 μL liquid at the bottom of the tube during washing steps.
Elute His∗6-tagged ubiquitinated proteins with 50 μL 1× elution buffer.
Boil samples for 5 min at 100°C.
Centrifuge boiled samples at 16,000 × g at 20-25°C for 1-2 minutes.
Store centrifuged samples at -20°C freezer for further analysis using Western blot.
Prepare SDS-PAGE gels by making a separation gel (10%).
Mix reagents in the following order to prepare the separation gel.
Pour the separation gel, leaving ∼2 cm below the bottom of the comb for the stacking gel.
Remove bubbles from the poured gel with isopropanol.
Wait approximately 30 minutes for the gel to polymerize completely.
Wash out remaining traces of isopropanol with distilled water after polymerization.
Prepare a stacking gel (5%).
Pour the stacking gel on top of the separation gel.
Add combs to make wells in the gels.
Wait approximately 30 minutes for the stacking gel to become fully polymerized.
Load whole extract proteins (∼15-30 μg) into wells for separation by electrophoresis.
Load ubiquitinated proteins (∼100-150 μg) and molecular mass protein markers into wells.
Run the gel and transfer proteins from the gel to a membrane.
Run the gels at 60-80 V constant voltage for stacking gel (30 min).
Increase voltage to 100-150 V for separating gel (1 h).
Remove the gel from the electrophoresis apparatus and equilibrate it by soaking in 1× Transfer Buffer for 10 min.
Place the equilibrated gel in the "transfer sandwich" (filter paper-gel-membrane-filter paper), cushioned by pads.
Press together the transfer sandwich using a support grid.
Run at 80 V constant voltage for 2 h or at 100 V for 90 min on ice.
Detect proteins after transfer.
Prepare blocking buffer and block the membrane for 1 h at 20-25°C using blocking buffer.
Add a primary antibody diluted in 10 mL blocking buffer.
Incubate for 16–18 hours at 4°C.
Wash the membranes three times with 1 X TBST buffer for 10 minutes each time.
Add secondary antibody in 10 mL blocking buffer.
Shake gently at 20–25°C for 1 hour.
Wash the membranes three times with 1 X TBST buffer for 10 minutes each time.
Add developing reagent on the membrane, monitoring development using ChemiDocTM XRS+.
Analyze the image using LabTM Software (Bio-Rad, USA).
Seed HepG2 and HCCLM3 cells in 96-well plates at a density of 3,000 cells per well in 100 μL fresh DMEM medium for CCK-8 assay.
Transfect cells with the indicated plasmids according to step 2 procedures.
Add 10 μL of the CCK-8 solution to each well after transfection.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 2–3 hours.
Measure absorbance at 450 nm using a Microplate Reader (Thermo Scientific, USA).
